title: Food spoilage and deterioration are different
summary: Freezing and shelter address different ways stored food can be lost.
body: Perishable food can spoil at warm temperatures; exposed items can also lose hit points through deterioration. A frozen meal outdoors can still deteriorate, while a sheltered warm meal can still spoil. Before diagnosing a food shortage, inspect storage temperature, roof/shelter, actual food type and its remaining shelf life, along with production and consumption. Do not infer adequate reserves from a meal count alone.
